_doc: SPINOFF-1 (owner, 2026-11-17): Ultrastable generates its own seeds. An unsupervised loop ideates apps, scores them for expected impact and reach, launches the best on *.ultrastable.app, measures each with metrics it generates itself, and a portfolio manager allocates, iterates, promotes or retires them by measured value. Read by foundation/spinoff.py; checked by `python3 -m foundation spinoff --check`. Weights, caps and thresholds are hypotheses the loop re-tunes from settled outcomes (ops/spinoff/outcomes.jsonl); never hand-edit a number to clear a breach.

sources.what: system needs a small owner does not know to ask for; the public checkable ones are apps
python3 -m foundation ignorance: known minus told
what inputs and changes recur; repeated end_user suggestions are demand
tenant data; used only in aggregate and only if public

domain-check.what: reads only public pages and DNS of the domain the visitor types and reports what is missing

template-generator.what: fills a draft document from choices; nothing stored

status-board.what: a public read-only board of measured facts from committed files; no database, no input, no personal data

live-feed.what: SPINOFF-GOOD-1: a public-benefit board read live from a public open-data source at request time; no database, no input, no personal data, no model call

live-lookup.input: a public domain name or a public country code or place name
live-lookup.what: SPINOFF-GOOD-1: one lookup against a public source for a public domain, a country code or a place name, answered live and stored nowhere

score.formula: reach * impact * feasibility * novelty * bandit / (1 + cost)
score.reach_scale: 1 to 5, log of plausible monthly users: 1 under 100, 2 under 1k, 3 under 10k, 4 under 100k, 5 above
score.impact_scale: 1 to 5: 1 curiosity, 3 saves an hour or avoids a mistake, 5 prevents a loss or a legal exposure

allowed_inputs: a public country code or place name
a public domain name or a public country code or place name
rules: an app may read only public pages and public DNS of a domain the visitor types, never anything behind a login

an app stores aggregate counts, a daily-salted visitor hash, and the typed public domain only as a one-way keyed hash with a bitmask of failed checks (to tell a fix from a first look); never an address, name, IP or the readable domain
an app states what it did and does not give legal, medical or financial advice
an app that fails any rule is not launched and the rejection is recorded with the rule that failed

a live app (SPINOFF-GOOD-1) shows only what its named public source returns at request time, links that source, serves /api/freshness, stores nothing about the visitor, takes only a public domain, country code or place name as input, and states that it is information, not advice

budget.note: free tier only: Cloudflare Workers free requests, one shared D1, no paid model calls; the ceiling is zero. The daily launch count is set by the free-tier governor level (doctrine/spinoff-ideas.json cadence), so the loop fills headroom and never spends past it.

check_library.title: Serves over HTTPS
check_library.fix: Redirect http to https and serve a valid certificate.

check_library.title: Publishes /.well-known/security.txt (RFC 9116)
check_library.fix: Publish a security.txt with a Contact line so researchers can report a flaw privately.

check_library.title: Has an SPF record
check_library.fix: Add a TXT record starting v=spf1 that lists who may send mail for the domain.

check_library.title: Has a DMARC record
check_library.fix: Add a TXT record at _dmarc with at least v=DMARC1; p=none; rua=mailto:you@yourdomain.

check_library.title: Links a privacy notice from the home page
check_library.fix: Say what you keep and link it in the footer.

check_library.title: Links terms of use from the home page
check_library.fix: Publish terms and link them in the footer.

check_library.title: Links an accessibility statement from the home page
check_library.fix: Publish an accessibility statement and link it in the footer.

value.definition: Value is a problem moved toward its target, counted as a verified outcome for a person, not attention. Each app names the gap it works on (share of public safeguards missing), and value is how much of that gap its users verifiably closed, whether they came back, and whether it reached people who actually had the gap. Same shape as Practical Solutions' gap-to-target ranking (worker/src/problems.js: shortfall to a stated target in [0,1]), applied to the apps' own problems.

measured_by.gap_closed: verified_fixes_7d: checks that failed on an earlier use of a domain and pass on a recheck
measured_by.reached_with_gap: visitors_with_a_gap_7d: unique visitors whose result had at least one failing check

lineage.qnfo-idea-hub: mined from QNFO/qnfo-workers idea-hub (public): kept IDEA-DIVERSITY-CAP-1 (no topic over half of accepts), the feasibility and risk gates beside the score, IDEA-NOVELTY-1 (screen against what already exists), REENTRY (a shipped output's own open questions become new signals) and REACH-IDEATION-1 (live checks of one's own public surfaces file fix items; done here as Q-BLINDSPOT-SELF-*). Superseded: scored papers; now deployed apps scored on verified outcomes.
